title: Existence of stable Lur'e systems for which the O'Shea-Zames-Falb stability test fails
summary: In this note we show that the well-known stability test proposed by O'Shea, Zames and Falb is not necessary for robust stability of Lur'e systems with slope-restricted nonlinearities and thereby disprove a conjecture by J. Carrasco. Specifically we construct a full-block multiplier which certifies stability of a constructed Lur'e interconnection that does not admit an OZF multiplier.
